thread:
mei: FYI starting int8 rollout for orionx-v0.9 on the sampling canary. Quick smoke shows weird spacing and invisible chars around numbers in CJK and occasional bracket mirroring in Arabic.
rajesh: can you share a tiny repro and whether this happens in greedy?
mei: only in sampling so far. greedy / beam look okay. minimal input that surfaced it: 
mei: ```
input: 今日の価格は￥1,200-です。(続き)
fp16_out: 今日の価格は￥1,200-です。(続き)
int8_out: 今日の価格は￥1,200  -です。(続き)
```
mei: note the NBSP (\u00a0) before the hyphen and an extra space around the numeric comma in some samples. detok removes differently between runs.
anya: NBSP or ZWNBSP? those often come from merging token pieces after quantization. is tokenizer normalization enabled?
mei: yes normalize_nfkc=true on baseline. same config used for int8 container.
rajesh: could be a rounding/drift in logits that sampling amplifies. can you dump token id streams and map to unicode points?
mei: I have a dump for one run (seed=777): token ids diverge at pos 37. fp16 chose id 9421, int8 chose 9421 as well but the underlying bytes map to slightly different subtoken (one with NBSP). weird.
marta: separate issue: I saw Arabic paren flipping in a different sample. input had: "(مرحبا)" and some int8 samples produced ")مرحبا(." Likely detok reordering because of token boundary including directional control.
rajesh: plan: 1) reproduce deterministically with seed and identical sampling RNG across both runtimes; 2) run N=2500 sampling trials and diff detok outputs to get rates; 3) bisect quant mapping per-MatMul kernel (I can script this); 4) try toggling tokenizer preserve_whitespace and output_normalization flags to see if masking helps.
anya: add an automated assertion in the eval harness that flags control/dir/nbspace/zwj chars in final detok for CJK/RTL test slices. If rate > 0.5% for canary, fail.
mei: repro curl (test rig):
mei: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://rbw-test.example/v1/generate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer test-key"
  -d '{"model":"orionx-v0.9-int8","input":"今日の価格は￥1,200-です。(続き)","max_tokens":48,"temperature":0.7,"top_p":0.9,"seed":777}'
```
rajesh: I'll run token-stream diffs and attach a small script to compare combining classes (regex for ZWJ/ZWNJ/NBSP/CR/LR/ALM).
marta: I'll add the unit test in the harness and include a small set of CJK/Arabic examples. will push a draft PR.
anya: note to triage: check detok codepath differences between our python client and the in-container C++ detok (there's a subtle normalize step).
mei: filing a short incident tag so monitoring picks this up: canary-int8/orionx -> sampling-regress. tagging @marta @rajesh. :mag:
deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled: orionx-v0.9-int8 -> sampling-test at 2025-11-21T09:00Z
mei: thanks, will post bisect logs + N=2500 sample summary here when done.
